newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker levels stable in listless trade.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker levels stable in listless trade.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes were stable on Friday but sentiment was sluggish with low trading interest ahead of the weekend, traders said.
The 380-cst grade was offered at around $100 per tonne and the 180-cst was at about $103. "Enquiries are scarce today due to a weekend mood," said one supplier.
Traders expected traded levels for bunker 380-cst supplies at below $100 per tonne later in the day.
MDO and gas oil were also stable, quoted at around $160 and $170 per tonne respectively.
